name: file-watch
description: Cross-process file awareness: notices when files this session touched change outside its tool calls

notify.description: Inject a system notice into LLM requests while tracked files have unresolved external changes

writeGuard.description: Block 'overwrite' when the target changed externally since the session last read it, so foreign work is not silently clobbered

ignore.description: Patterns matched on path-segment boundaries against absolute paths (dist/ matches any dist directory, not mydist/); matching files are never tracked
